specs.title: História preserva shell, cinco abas e entrada em Tarefas; Execução concentra a decisão
Gateway usa confirmação inline com foco e preserva o comando, corpo e autoria originais
mudança de versão durante a confirmação exige revisar a decisão nova
editar mantém formulário e rascunho centrais, sem decisão concorrente ou escrita ao cancelar
queued mostra a situação observada sem botão fictício de continuar
running mostra a situação observada sem botão fictício de continuar
persona de consulta e tentativa histórica não liberam aprovação por caminhos secundários
Gateway permanece no shell e acessível por teclado em celular e altura reduzida
Componentes legado consulta o repositório herdado sem escolhas e conserva filtros e retorno pelo Sistema
mais de um repositório legado permanece consultável sem escolha automática ou mutação
pedido incerto permite consultar o repositório herdado e retornar antes de reconciliar a intenção original
confirmação incerta reconcilia a mesma intenção após recarga sem repetir o efeito
nome Gateway não reescreve conteúdo de plano registrado pelo agente
acervo conserva o estado registrado e o destino em consulta sem ações operacionais
pendência de repositório conserva a razão do backend e leva ao Sistema com retorno ao recorte da História
Projeto e Tarefa consultam o mesmo repositório do Sistema sem escopo ou seleção próprios
Ana solicita a criação única e neutra no Sistema ativo; consulta e inatividade não permitem criar
Task editing uses a central mobile form and unique header actions, and Cancel restores its prior central process section
central Task edit preserves its draft across tabs, permission changes and a rejected save before confirming the versioned PATCH
a lost central Task edit acknowledgement retries the original PATCH identity without applying the update twice
Story creates a Task in the central form with one Save and Cancel in the header and preserves a cancelled draft across tabs
a lost central Task creation acknowledgement keeps its draft and retries the same idempotency identity
central Story editing retains a rejected draft across persona and tab changes and can be confirmed from the header
Story remains macro and task drill down keeps phase and one place for interaction
Story cycle stays visible across tabs, Task navigation and reload at 1440px without commands
Story cycle stays visible across tabs, Task navigation and reload at 390px without commands
Merge Request indicator respects current journey and SECURITY SCAN without changing lifecycle
Merge Request indicator respects current journey and TESTING without changing lifecycle
Merge Request indicator respects current journey and CANCELLED without changing lifecycle
blocked merge explains Draft and resolution before retry in Story and Task at 1440px
blocked merge explains Draft and resolution before retry in Story and Task at 390px
merge failure requests reconciliation without claiming a confirmed blocker; resolved state clears old diagnosis
Draft is released from the assistant with separate confirmation and no merge at 1440px
Draft is released from the assistant with separate confirmation and no merge at 390px
assistant requests architect diagnosis inside the portal and preserves specialist attribution without release writes
unknown Draft release offers result verification without claiming Draft remains or requesting another release confirmation
the Specification Gateway requires review and confirmation, and an uncertain G1 request reuses its identity after reload
historical evidence and other tasks cannot execute the current review
a lost correction confirmation can be reconciled with its original identity after the current task changes
processing distinguishes screen connection, executor heartbeat and last real tool event
planned work binding has explicit scope and a completion criterion without silently completing tasks
existing results remain readable without creating artificial process tasks
a binding draft keeps its original concurrency token until the user reviews a newer selection
a newer assistant conversation never replaces the canonical blocked merge attempt
manual task status updates preserve the active central planning section from DOING through DONE
refreshing the same item preserves edit and binding drafts and the interaction section
desktop and mobile keep both Story and Task processes central without any interaction sidebar
legacy Task interaction URLs normalize to central process views and survive reload without writes
